WITH station_thermal AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationregistry,
        l.locationtype,
        l.stationname,
        (t.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::numeric as solar_output,
        (t.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::numeric as wind_output,
        t.fuelcelloutputw as fuel_cell_output,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.thermaleqref) as num_equipment
    FROM location l
    JOIN communication c ON l.locationregistry = c.commlocref
    JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON c.commregistry = t.thermalcommref
    WHERE (t.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::numeric > 0
       OR (t.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::numeric > 0
    GROUP BY l.locationregistry, l.locationtype, l.stationname, 
             t.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w',
             t.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w',
             t.fuelcelloutputw
),
station_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        locationtype,
        stationname,
        num_equipment,
        ROUND(CAST((solar_output + wind_output) / (fuel_cell_output + solar_output + wind_output) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as rec,
        ROUND(CAST(solar_output + wind_output AS numeric), 2) as total_renewable_power
    FROM station_thermal
)
SELECT 
    locationtype,
    stationname,
    num_equipment,
    rec as reliance_on_renewables,
    total_renewable_power,
    CASE 
        WHEN rec > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable'
        WHEN rec > 50 AND rec <= 70 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable'
        ELSE 'Low Sustainability'
    END as classification
FROM station_calc
ORDER BY rec DESC;

args.sql:
WITH station_thermal AS (
    SELECT 
        l.locationtype,
        l.stationname,
        (t.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::numeric as solar_output,
        (t.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::numeric as wind_output,
        t.fuelcelloutputw as fuel_cell_output
    FROM location l
    JOIN communication c ON l.locationregistry = c.commlocref
    JOIN thermalsolarwindandgrid t ON c.commregistry = t.thermalcommref
    WHERE (t.renewablemetrics->'solar'->>'output_w')::numeric > 0
       OR (t.renewablemetrics->'wind'->>'output_w')::numeric > 0
),
station_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        locationtype,
        stationname,
        ROUND(CAST((solar_output + wind_output) / (fuel_cell_output + solar_output + wind_output) * 100 AS numeric), 2) as rec,
        CASE 
            WHEN (solar_output + wind_output) / (fuel_cell_output + solar_output + wind_output) * 100 > 70 THEN 'Energy-Sustainable'
            WHEN (solar_output + wind_output) / (fuel_cell_output + solar_output + wind_output) * 100 > 50 AND (solar_output + wind_output) / (fuel_cell_output + solar_output + wind_output) * 100 <= 70 THEN 'Moderately Sustainable'
            ELSE 'Low Sustainability'
        END as classification
    FROM station_thermal
)
SELECT 
    locationtype,
    ROUND(AVG(rec), 2) as avg_rec,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN classification = 'Energy-Sustainable' THEN stationname END) as num_energy_sustainable_stations
FROM station_calc
GROUP BY locationtype
ORDER BY avg_rec DESC;
